title: Govt evaluating IDBI Bank financial bids

timeline.title: Govt evaluating IDBI Bank financial bids
timeline.line: Sale of 60.72% stake moving steadily; Fairfax and Emirates NBD in the race
more: The Government (30.48%) and LIC (30.24%) are selling jointly
Revised bids came in on July 13 after the first round missed the reserve price
Fairfax's reported ₹81/share offer values the stake at about ₹53,000 cr
